resources.string: AI-Based Fake Identity, Biometric Voice & Credential Screening System
Smart India Hackathon 2026 — Problem Statement SIH26188 (MHA)
Screening for AI voice clones, fake authority & digital arrest threats
Extracts high-frequency acoustic features in real-time to detect voice cloning artifacts.
Audio is processed strictly on-device. Raw audio is never saved or uploaded.
Enables VoiceGuard to screen unknown callers against the threat intelligence registry before ringing.
